title: CrlChecker anchor path: the discovery arm and the §4.14 domain check are unpinned
description:
## Why

`check_revocation_against_anchor` has a discovery arm and a §4.14 domain check
that no test distinguishes.

## The survivors

    crl.rs:822:42  replace match guard `self.signer_discovered` with true
    crl.rs:822:42  replace match guard `self.signer_discovered` with false
    crl.rs:867:13  replace && with || in the (2c) conjunction
    crl.rs:868:13  replace && with ||
    crl.rs:867:16  delete ! in the (2c) conjunction
    crl.rs:868:16  delete !

822 is `(Some(discovered), false) if self.signer_discovered`, the arm that
makes a discovered signer authoritative regardless of the CRL's
`IDP.indirectCRL` flag. Always false, a discovered signer on a direct CRL
reports `IndirectCrlIssuerUnexpected`; always true, a caller-supplied
`crl_issuer_cert` is treated as discovered.

867/868 are the (2c) check, whose own comment explains why it is not a
restatement of (2a) and (2b):

    if self.signer_discovered
        && !crl_declares_indirect
        && !names_match(cert.issuer, crl.issuer)

Under discovery, (2a) ties the CRL issuer to the discovered signer's subject
while (2b) ties the certificate to the anchor, leaving the two free to
disagree. Weaken any of the three conjuncts and that gap reopens on the anchor
path.

## What a test needs

The anchor path with `new_with_signer_discovery`, which
`signer_discovery.rs`'s own test module exercises only through
`check_revocation`. The fixtures there (bridge / new_key_ca) are the right
shapes; what is missing is driving them against a `TrustAnchor`.

## Found by

The first pkix-revocation mutation sweep, 2026-11-27.
close_reason: All six mutants killed. tests/anchor_path_signer.rs, four tests, one per reachable arm of the (cRLIssuer, indirectCRL) pairing. The indirect-crl-crlsign fixture set gained direct-crl.der: reaching each arm needs an indirect CRL and a direct one from the same issuer and it had only the indirect half. The third name check's three conjuncts are individually load-bearing only under discovery with a direct CRL, which is why all six survived a suite that drives this method with CrlChecker::new alone.
